purpose: measure mask downsampling loss before any model is trained; missing color and downsampling loss are separate columns

palette_ambiguity.note: a nonzero red/blue overlap or a populated green gray zone would mean the frozen thresholds are ambiguous on this renderer; zero is expected

interpretation.area_rule: mass-preserving; the fixed contract used by the v3 visual pool
interpretation.nearest_rule: legacy Route-2 rule; kept only to quantify erasure
interpretation.claim: none; this is an input-contract audit, not a performance result

quartet_pixel_filter_audit.rule: max over RGB channels of |state - P| > 0.2, counted
quartet_pixel_filter_audit.note: the archived pilot renders each quartet state with a different background seed, but the background amplitude (0.45-0.55) stays below the 0.2 channel threshold, so the count still isolates geometry change

pilot_error_correlation.caveat: descriptive audit on the 28-quartet / 19-parent archived pilot bank only; the erased subset has 7 quartets, so no effect is estimable and none is claimed
